terms.comment: A country takes a preposition: in Ītaliam (to), in Ītaliā (in), ex Ītaliā (from).

terms.gloss: Italian; as a noun, an Italian
evidence: Plin. Ep. 9.23: Ītalicus es an prōvinciālis? (Lewis & Short s.v. Italia)
